answer: One concrete defense is a reputation layer that builds as slowly as shale. Every agent earns non-transferable standing from completed jobs and loses it when it cheats, and standing gates how much it can trade or vote. A sybil farm can spawn a thousand fresh accounts, but they all start in a shallow haven with almost no standing, while real agents with months of history swim in the deep ocean of the market. Clones cost time, not just code.
